title: Automated Multi-Agent Organization Design: From Architecture Search to Organizational Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.27531v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agentic system design is increasingly shifting from hand-crafted prompts and workflows toward automated search over agentic programs and interaction structures, with multi-agent systems receiving growing attention. Yet a central question remains unresolved: when does an automatically generated multi-agent structure exhibit a functionally meaningful division of responsibility? We argue that automated multi-agent design should move beyond searching for effective architectures toward identifying which responsibilities are functionally necessary, how they should be allocated, and when they should change. To explore this, we propose Automated Multi-Agent Organization Design (AMOD), which treats organization itself as a first-class design object, explicitly modeling how agent teams are composed, what functional responsibilities the agents assume, how they coordinate, and how collective decisions are made. translated_title: 自动化多智能体组织设计：从架构搜索到组织学习
translated_abstract: 智能体系统设计正日益从手工编写的提示词和工作流，转向对智能体程序与交互结构的自动化搜索，其中多智能体系统正受到越来越多的关注。然而，一个核心问题仍未解决：自动生成的多智能体结构何时才能展现出功能上有意义的职责分工？我们认为，自动化多智能体设计应当超越单纯搜索有效架构，转向识别哪些职责在功能上是必要的、这些职责应如何分配、以及何时应该改变。为探索这一问题，我们提出了自动化多智能体组织设计（AMOD），它将组织本身作为一等设计对象，显式建模智能体团队如何组成、智能体承担哪些功能性职责、它们如何协调配合、以及如何进行集体决策。我们将AMOD表述为一种执行驱动（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出AMOD框架，将组织本身作为一等设计对象进行显式建模，推动自动化多智能体设计从单纯搜索有效架构，转向识别功能上必要的职责、其分配方式及变更时机。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes AMOD, which treats organization itself as a first-class design object, shifting automated multi-agent design from architecture search toward identifying functionally necessary responsibilities, how to allocate them, and when they should change.
